        About this item

        • Compatibility: only for iPhone Air/17/17e/16/15/14/13/12 series, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra/S26+/S26/S25 Ultra/S25 +/S25 with a magnetic case; recommended to use with official or ESR magnetic cases; not compatible with Motorola, OnePlus, and Google phones
        • Fast Charging: intelligent heat management and 15W charging enable speeds nearly identical to official MagSafe chargers; 18W QC adapter required for fast charging (not included)
        • Secure Magnetic Lock: powerful magnets with 1,600 g of holding force and a non-slip silicone ring keep your phone securely in place, even when driving on bumpy roads; an official MagSafe case or ESR magnetic case is recommended for rough terrain
        • Ready for Navigation: single-handedly switch between portrait and landscape for easy navigation
        • Stable Vent Mount: strong vent clip and support arm provide enhanced mounting stability
        • What‘s Included: MagSafe Car Mount Charger, air vent clamp, dashboard anchor, 3.3 ft (1 m) USB-A to USB-C cable, and manual; car charging adapter not included
        • Complete Customer Support: detailed setup videos, FAQs, a comprehensive 12-month protection plan, unlimited support, and personalized help

          • DS
            5 out of 5 stars
            Great Product and Compatibility
            Reviewed in India on 1 November 2025
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            I drive a Honda City — an amazing car overall — but there’s one small design flaw that’s always bugged me: there’s literally no proper place to keep your phone. And to make it trickier, there’s hardly any good spot to mount a phone holder, except for the windshield or the AC vents.

            Windshield mounts end up blocking a part of your view — which can get pretty annoying (and sometimes scary) when you suddenly spot an e-rickshaw or two-wheeler out of nowhere. On the other hand, most AC vent mounts available online are either flimsy, have no proper padding, or restrict the vent movement entirely. Hit one pothole, and you’re likely to break either the vent or the holder.

            I’ve been using this particular mount for over a month now, and I’m genuinely impressed. After driving about 2,200 km across state highways and city roads that seem designed to last two business days (or 30 minutes of rain), my phone never once fell. The grip is excellent.

            If I had to nitpick, I’d say the ball joint that determines the phone’s orientation could be slightly improved — but that’s really minor. I’d love to share that feedback directly with the design team.

            I’d have attached a picture with this review, but my car’s currently at the service center — and let’s be honest, I’ll probably forget by the time I get it back.

            As an Amazon seller myself, I believe in writing honest reviews — not just to help other buyers make informed decisions, but also to appreciate and motivate brands that are genuinely doing good work.

            4 out of 5 stars
            Amazing product, its going to hold your heavy phone
            Reviewed in India on 6 January 2023
            Verified Purchase

              Review after 6 months now.

              Pros:

              1. Its plastic but firm and well built

              2. It will hold your iphone 14 pro max (heavy) if you use it with a genuine magsafe case. You cannot expect same grip with cheap magsafe cases. It holds in road bumps and normal gutters. It takes a pretty heavy shake to displace it from the magsafe hold. But you would be worried about the car more than phone at this point. Here i rarely encounter gutter, put road bumps are plenty and some very rough as well. Never had a problem there. The only time it slipped off is when I accidentally hit it with my hand. So you need not worry about the magsafe grip if you use genuine case.

              3. Wireless charging speed is normal (not fast charge) but this is acceptable as it will not heat up your device more. Turning ac will help to cool it down. Also if you need fast charge you can connect phone directly to your usb fast charger while it is mounted on it. Wireless charge disables automatically when you do this.

              4. When you mount your phone, just slide your phone against the device and you’ll see magnet pulls it to the correct position. Yes magnet is strong.

              5. I connect the cable only when i need to charge. 90% of the time i use it just as a mount as I dont want to ruin battery. Just unplug the usb.

              Cons:

              1. The three point support leg doesnt work as advertised. It will slip to lower level if your phone is heavy, but this doesn’t bother me as you need to adjust the level at once, get your angle right, and leave it there.

              Few other points to notice:

              You’ll see the whole unit moves as one when it shakes on rough roads. First i was concerned but later realised this is actually a good thing, as it absorbs most of the shock and keep phone tight on magsafe hold. (If the mount was very sturdy then it might end up displacing the magsafe hold) So thats not a worry any more.

              Now after 6 months of use i love the product and trust it completely to hold my phone. Use of phone for maps has become quite easier. I say go for it only if you have a good magsafe case.

            • Rakesh Patel
              5 out of 5 stars
              A reliable and must have product
              Reviewed in India on 31 August 2022
              Verified Purchase
              Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
              Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

              I already have Apple Airplay supported in my car. Still the convenience of using maps etc on your phone directly is much more convenient. I have spent a lot on car mounts from brands such as Spigen etc but they never felt like a snug fit.

              This product serves two purposes. One, as a solid car mount so that I can use my phone directly in my car. And second, as a wireless charger while the phone just sits there. I have clubbed this charger with an 18w adapter for fast charging.

              Being MagSafe compatible, the charger works perfectly with my iPhone 12 Pro. At the beginning I felt the product was pricy given that you would need to buy an 18w adapter as well but every other product that does the same functions would cost you more. Also, if you register as a VIP member once you receive your product, you get a 24 months worth of warranty which makes the deal even more VFM.

              I am happy with the product and will keep posting its long term review with eventual usage.
